title: Rows for a 3-band compressor (GT01)
author: naturarum
description: EXPERIMENT: emulator-tested only, never run on a unit. Adds 17 parameter rows, through param-grow, for a 3-band master compressor that does not exist yet: per band (LOW, MID, HIGH) threshold, ratio, attack, release and makeup, and two crossovers. They are inert: on no page, with no MIDI CC or NRPN, never p-lockable, no randomiser, default 0, in FX slots 70..86 that no stock row uses and the stock storage does not keep. Nothing on the screen, in MIDI or in a saved project changes. For dn2-cfw's GT01 build.
